recon_step: v5.5.0 §1.5 OFFICIAL-VENUE TEST — Auction.com for Ocean County NJ

default_classification.rationale: PRIMARY_EVENT_SOURCE only in counties where recon documents that the sheriff / trustee officially conducts the sale through Auction.com; otherwise REJECTED_SOURCE.

ocean_county_sheriff_official_page.verbatim_venue_text: Sheriff's Sales are held at Administration Building 101 Hooper Avenue, Room 119
ocean_county_sheriff_official_page.verbatim_timing_text: Sales are conducted on Tuesdays at 2:00 pm except on legal holidays

final_verdict_rationale: Ocean County Sheriff's own foreclosures page designates the in-person venue (101 Hooper Avenue, Room 119, Tuesdays 2pm). No designation of Auction.com on the sheriff's page, sale-announcement page, or homepage. Per §1.5 the required evidence (an official_designation_url + officer_or_office) is ABSENT, so Auction.com falls back to REJECTED_SOURCE.  Auction.com's https://www.auction.com/residential/nj/ocean-county listings are a MARKETPLACE RE-LISTING of events conducted by the Ocean County Sheriff in-person — exactly the §1.5 disqualifier.
lead_value_lost: Zero. S1 sheriff_foreclosure already carries the complete row-set per the sheriff's own PDF (chancery docket, plaintiff, defendant, upset, adjournment, address). Auction.com's re-listings derive from the same source.
